traits.name: Ruthless
traits.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2%.

traits.name: Blood Fury
traits.text: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

traits.name: Hardiness
traits.text: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

traits.name: Savage
traits.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1%.

traits.name: Find Treasure
traits.text: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until canceled.

traits.name: Stoneform
traits.text: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

traits.name: Shadowmeld
traits.text: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

traits.name: Quickness
traits.text: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

traits.name: Wisp Spirit
traits.text: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

traits.name: Will of the Forsaken
traits.text: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

traits.name: Cannibalize
traits.text: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

traits.name: War Stomp
traits.text: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

traits.name: Endurance
traits.text: Total Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.

traits.name: Cultivation
traits.text: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

traits.name: Escape Artist
traits.text: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

traits.name: Engineering Specialization
traits.text: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

traits.name: Berserking
traits.text: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.
